meta.note: Extracted from the official KIT module handbook for the B.Sc. Mechanical Engineering International (MEI), SPO 2024, Winter Term 2024/25 edition dated 2024-08-29 (168 pages; all cited page numbers are pages of this exact PDF, which reprints the Study and Examination Regulations pp.8-23 and their correction p.25); newer semester reprints of the same SPO 2024 handbook exist (latest Winter Semester 2026/27, dated 2026-08-18) and some module rules have since changed (e.g. a CAE-Basics Workshop gate was added), so this dataset is deliberately pinned to the 2024-08-29 edition; the app displays this data as an unofficial convenience reference only, the authoritative source is the PDF itself.
